summary: Probed the agent server directly over its websocket to determine whether the agent for session 01a063c1-5fda-748d-8cbb-039df16aec5e was still running, and found it is idle — the last message is a complete reply written at 20:30:37 UTC that the browser never rendered. Diagnosed that the client's view of the session drifted because session.resume snapshots carry no state field, the client never tracks event ids to detect gaps, and there is no heartbeat, so a stalled socket or reconnect mid-turn leaves the page stuck in a stale streaming state.
decisions: Authoritative source for agent liveness is the agent server itself, queried via websocket, not the browser client's last received session.state event
The session resume protocol should include a session state field so reconnecting clients always learn whether the agent is running
The client should track event ids and re-request a snapshot on any gap or reconnect, rather than trusting only the last session.state event it observed
A heartbeat is needed so a silent socket is detected within seconds instead of never
errors: Browser tab stopped rendering messages for session 01a063c1-5fda-748d-8cbb-039df16aec5e even though the server finished and emitted a complete final reply and idle state — caused by the client missing events after a disconnect mid-turn with no resync mechanism
